content.title: City Plans
content.summary: Arvada's city government is actively developing several master plans, including the Parks System Master Plan, Lake Arbor Center and Golf Course Master Plan, and a 30-year Blunn/Pioneer Master Plan, all aimed at enhancing community resources and infrastructure. Additionally, the city is working on a 10-year Capital Improvement Plan to address infrastructure needs and a Climate Action and Sustainability Plan to promote resilience and sustainability over the next 25 years. A Transportation Systems Plan is also being initiated to improve the transportation network for the future.
content.body:
## Parks and Open Space

### Arvada Parks System Master Plan

The City's current Master Plan was adopted in 2016 and is based on City Council's Strategic Goals. An inventory of existing conditions and an analysis of community needs, based on input provided by Arvada residents through survey responses and comments made in a series of public workshops and other forums, were integral to the plan development.

- Visit the [Parks System Master Plan page](/509/Arvada-Park-System-Master-Plan) and download related documents.

### Lake Arbor Center and Golf Course Master Plan

The City is developing the Lake Arbor Center and Golf Course Master Plan, an initiative designed to envision the future of the [Lake Arbor Center and Pool](https://apexprd.org/facility/lake-arbor-center-outdoor-pool/) (7451 W. 83rd Way) and the [Lake Arbor Golf Course](https://lakearborgolf.com/) (8600 Wadsworth Blvd.)

- [Visit the Lake Arbor Center and Golf Course Master Plan page](/1130) to learn more about the project.

### Blunn/Pioneer Master Plan

A 30-year Master Plan is being conducted for the 1,600-acre primarily undeveloped property located north of West 64th Avenue, east of Highway 93, south of Leyden Road and west of Virgil Street including the Arvada/Blunn Reservoir, Tucker Lake, Pioneer Sand and Gravel quarry, and nearby open space areas. Existing and future uses for this property are being considered.

- Visit the [Blunn/Pioneer Master Plan page](/511/Blunn-Pioneer-Master-Plan) and download related documents.

## Budget (Transparency)

### Capital Improvement Plan

The 10-year Capital Improvement Plan (CIP) identifies the short and long term infrastructure needs identified by the City for all of its Work Systems, including: Organizational and Service Effectiveness, Vibrant Community and Neighborhoods, Safe Community, Infrastructure and Community and Economic Development. The intent of the CIP is to balance the identified needs of the City with the available resources.

- Visit the [Capital Improvement Plan page](/311/Capital-Improvement-Plan) to view related documents.

## Plan Arvada (Current & Long Range Plans) (Development in Arvada)

### Comprehensive Plan

The 2014 Comprehensive Plan articulates the community's shared values and vision. Goals and policies help guide development and investment decisions that influence the quality of life in Arvada. The Plan establishes the City's land use pattern, sets the stage for development regulations and standards, and guides the City in funding programs and capital investments by anticipating future tax revenue. The Plan was prepared to conform to the requirements in the Colorado Revised Statues.

- [Comprehensive Plan](/307/2014-Comprehensive-Plan)

## Sustainability

### Climate Action and Sustainability Plan

In early 2024, the City of Arvada began working on developing the City’s first [Climate and Sustainability Action Plan](https://www.arvadaco.gov/1028/Climate-Action-and-Sustainability-Plan) (CASAP). The CASAP will guide Arvada’s work to create a more resilient, vibrant, and sustainable community for the next 25 years. 

Prior to the development of the CASP, the Sustain Arvada Plan had been a guiding document with two primary components: The Municipal Action Plan and the Community Plan. While both plans strive to achieve a more sustainable community, the Municipal Action Plan, developed in 2010, defined and created a sustainable corporate identity for the City of Arvada. The Community Plan, adopted in 2012, focused on aspects of sustainability that relate to the entire Arvada population.

- Visit the [Sustainability page](/498/Conservation-Sustain-Arvada) for more information and resources.

## Transportation

### Transportation Systems Plan

In 2023, the City began developing Arvada's first Transportation Systems Plan (TSP). The TSP will identify challenges, opportunities, and strategies for improving Arvada's transportation network over the next 20+ years.

- Visit the [Transportation Systems Plan page](/1309) for more information.

### 2017 Bike Master Plan

Adopted by City Council in October 2017, the goals of the Bicycle Master Plan include building a connected and comfortable bicycle network, creating a safe place for all types of bicyclists to ride, turning bicycling into a convenient form of travel for all trips. As the Plan's recommendations are implemented, the following targets will help gauge the City's success in creating an Arvada that is connected, comfortable, safe, and convenient for bicycling.

- Visit the [Bike Master Plan page](/1477) for more information.

### Olde Town Parking & Transportation Demand Plan

Developed in 2010, the Olde Town Parking and Transportation Demand Plan determined short-term and long-term recommendations to improve parking and transportation in Olde Town Arvada.

- Download the [Olde Town Parking and Transportation Demand Plan (PDF)](https://library.municode.com/co/arvada/munidocs/munidocs?nodeId=68cbef0727afc).

### Arvada Transit Framework Plan

In 2007, the City of Arvada initiated the Arvada Transit Station Planning Project to study the individual needs of each of the Gold Line Stations-Sheridan, Olde Town and Kipling-in order to strengthen all three stations and better serve the community.

- Download the [Arvada Transit Framework Plan (PDF)](https://library.municode.com/co/arvada/munidocs/munidocs?nodeId=68b568f4217b7).
